svg.title: From delivery to acceptance and payment request
svg.desc: The officer records the delivery, members sign until the phase is accepted, the system issues certificates and tells Finance. Finance reads waiting phases and calls the payment gate. A pass creates the request; a failure is held as an exception. After approval Finance reports back and the phase becomes Paid.
